faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for MGU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in MGU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 23 vacancies: 2 Assistant Professor - School of Biosciences (Biophysics 1, Microbiology 1), 1 Assistant Professor - School of Pure and Applied Physics (Physics), 1 Assistant Professor - School of Physical Education and Sports Sciences (Physical Education), 1 Assistant Professor - School of Letters (English), 1 Assistant Professor - School of Computer Sciences (Computer Science), 1 Assistant Professor - Department of Lifelong Learning and Extension (Counselling) and 9 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for MGU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Interview Proforma attached with the notification (page 4 of the PDF)) and send it to The Registrar, Mahatma Gandhi University, Priyadarsini Hills P. O., Kottayam- 686 560, by ordinary post, to reach by 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 70 years (as on 1 January 2026).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Consolidated pay of ₹40,000 per month for Assistant Professor - School of Biosciences (Biophysics 1, Microbiology 1), Consolidated pay of ₹40,000 per month for Assistant Professor - School of Pure and Applied Physics (Physics), Consolidated pay of ₹40,000 per month for Assistant Professor - School of Physical Education and Sports Sciences (Physical Education), Consolidated pay of ₹40,000 per month for Assistant Professor - School of Letters (English), Consolidated pay of ₹40,000 per month for Assistant Professor - School of Computer Sciences (Computer Science).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: As per UGC norms. Candidates with a Degree / Ph.D. from universities or institutions outside Keralam must submit an equivalency/eligibility certificate from Mahatma Gandhi University. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Differently Abled / EWS candidates must enclose the certificate (as per State Govt. criteria) from the Competent Authority. Degree / Ph.D. from outside Keralam: equivalency/eligibility certificate from this University required.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Natives of States other than Keralam for posts notified exclusively under the community reservation quota.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely on contract basis for academic year 2026-2027, till April 15, 2027. Selected candidates shall execute an agreement with the University as per existing norms.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Mahatma Gandhi University, Kottayam.
